description: Defines an immutable Dart class 'NewsArticle' that models a news article with methods for mapping to and from database and API JSON representations.

classes.name: NewsArticle
classes.description: An immutable class representing a news article with various fields like headline, image, description, url, source, time, and content.

methods.name: toDbMap
methods.description: Converts the NewsArticle instance to a map suitable for database storage.

methods.name: fromDbMap
methods.description: Creates an instance of NewsArticle from a database record map.

methods.name: fromNewsApiJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of NewsArticle from a JSON object received from the News API.
